summary: TechCreate Group Ltd. (NYSE American: TCGL) filed a Form 6-K on June 23, 2026, announcing its appeal of a NYSE American Staff determination to commence delisting proceedings against its Class A Ordinary Shares. The delisting action stems from an SEC one-day trading suspension on February 2, 2026, citing potential manipulation, though no wrongdoing by the company or insiders has been alleged. The company engaged Dickinson Wright PLLC as legal counsel and filed its appeal on June 22, 2026. The company contests the delisting, arguing due process concerns. No financial terms or share price are disclosed. Watch the appeal outcome and trading resumption as key risk-arb factors.
